title: Samuel Starts Leaking

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text:
Here we are again... 

*giggle*
FIRE... FIRE... IT'S ALL FIRE.
*laugh*

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Here we are again... 

*giggle*
FIRE... FIRE... IT'S ALL FIRE.
*laugh*

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: *Argh* I beg your pardon? What was what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: *Argh* I beg your pardon? What was what?

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: No fire here, friend...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No fire here, friend...

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text:
You look like you've seen a ghost - *ugh* 

THE STREETS WILL BECOME YOU. *laugh*

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
You look like you've seen a ghost - *ugh* 

THE STREETS WILL BECOME YOU. *laugh*

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text:
Many people find me slightly strange- 

*ugh* 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME... 
*giggle*

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Many people find me slightly strange- 

*ugh* 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME 
KILL TIME... 
*giggle*

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Perhaps you're beginning to hear the voices...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps you're beginning to hear the voices...

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Today the voices are more distant. They arrive on the wind and leave on the breeze.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Today the voices are more distant. They arrive on the wind and leave on the breeze.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: You'll know this when you hear them, but sometimes when they speak, the voices comfort me in the way only a mother could. - *ugh* DROWN THE WEAK IN PIGS BLOOD! *laugh*

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'll know this when you hear them, but sometimes when they speak, the voices comfort me in the way only a mother could. - *ugh* DROWN THE WEAK IN PIGS BLOOD! *laugh*

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text:
*Argh*

Hold on... wait... I'm... where am I?

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
*Argh*

Hold on... wait... I'm... where am I?

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Oh thank the gods... I went to some back street eye doctor my friend recommended. I've been in a half dream since.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh thank the gods... I went to some back street eye doctor my friend recommended. I've been in a half dream since.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: I was... there were voices... so many voices... I was one of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was... there were voices... so many voices... I was one of them.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: No... god no... that would have at least been interesting. It was all just... train schedules, advertisements and recipes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... god no... that would have at least been interesting. It was all just... train schedules, advertisements and recipes.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Right... I must go. I had a pet lizard. He's probably long dead by now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right... I must go. I had a pet lizard. He's probably long dead by now.

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text:
*Argh*

THE FIRE SHALL BURN THE EDGES AND THE MIDDLE. THE FOUNDATIONS WILL CRUMBLE.

*laugh*

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
*Argh*

THE FIRE SHALL BURN THE EDGES AND THE MIDDLE. THE FOUNDATIONS WILL CRUMBLE.

*laugh*

nodes.speaker: Samuel Jaynes
nodes.text: Yes... voices... so many voices... I was one of them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... voices... so many voices... I was one of them.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is everything ok, Samuel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is everything ok, Samuel?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The thing you just said about the fire?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The thing you just said about the fire?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: The thing you just said about the fire?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: The thing you just said about the fire?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think you are having some kind of malfunction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think you are having some kind of malfunction.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think you are having some kind of malfunction.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think you are having some kind of malfunction.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You keep saying strange things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You keep saying strange things.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes! Do it now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes! Do it now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You think he might miss the voices?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think he might miss the voices?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You think he might miss the voices?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You think he might miss the voices?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nothing. I must have misheard you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. I must have misheard you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Nothing. I must have misheard you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Nothing. I must have misheard you.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: You didn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You didn't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ok what's going on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: He seems to be malfunctioning. His FERB score is going haywire.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He seems to be malfunctioning. His FERB score is going haywire.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Ok I'm picking up a strange signal being fed into some of his implants.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ok I'm picking up a strange signal being fed into some of his implants.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Thing is, he seems pretty attached to the voices, its become his religion. If I block it, it might kill them for good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thing is, he seems pretty attached to the voices, its become his religion. If I block it, it might kill them for good.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Would you miss me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you miss me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Probably not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Probably not.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's your call...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's your call...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: We can't allow him to keep walking the streets like this, he could be dangerous. Sever the connection.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We can't allow him to keep walking the streets like this, he could be dangerous. Sever the connection.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: We can't allow him to keep walking the streets like this, he could be dangerous. Sever the connection.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: We can't allow him to keep walking the streets like this, he could be dangerous. Sever the connection.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Let's leave him. They may be bad voices, but they're his bad voices.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's leave him. They may be bad voices, but they're his bad voices.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Let's leave him. They may be bad voices, but they're his bad voices.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Let's leave him. They may be bad voices, but they're his bad voices.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll keep an ear out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll keep an ear out.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Understood. Blocking now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Understood. Blocking now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The bustling streets of Nivalis!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The bustling streets of Nivalis!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're home.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're home.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened in your dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened in your dream?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did they say anything about serial murder?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did they say anything about serial murder?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Did they say anything about serial murder?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Did they say anything about serial murder?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems like some of the old AIs are leaking.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems like some of the old AIs are leaking.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seems like some of the old AIs are leaking.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seems like some of the old AIs are leaking.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: This is why they're shutting down the old network I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: This is why they're shutting down the old network I guess.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Be careful out there!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Be careful out there!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I never thought about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I never thought about it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Whoa, what was that?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whoa, what was that?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's that fire again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's that fire again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Are you hearing this from the voices?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you hearing this from the voices?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Are you hearing this from the voices?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Are you hearing this from the voices?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You keep saying random things.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You keep saying random things.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It's all rather simple binary. I could sever it?!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's all rather simple binary. I could sever it?!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You heard lots of voices.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You heard lots of voices.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Any interesting recipes you remember?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Any interesting recipes you remember?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you mentioned fire...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you mentioned fire...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck!
